title: Local Agentic Coding Solution for 6GB VRAM?
author: AsparagusOk8818
selftext:
...This is incredibly unlikely, but I don't suppose anyone knows of a local model that can reliably run (with somewhat reasonable speed) locally on just 6GB of VRAM (I don't have a mac)?

  
Open AI has officially spooked me. They had some kind of problem with GPT yesterday, and didn't even acknowledge the problem for hours. When it was finally fixed... IDK. It feels like Astra got brain damage or something. Maybe it's just me. 

Obviously this one problem isn't some kind of dealbreaker, outages happen... but it did make me fully appreciate just how dependent I am on a tool I have no control over the fate of (...there's a whole argument we could make about how we never really have such control anyway, but shelve that; I think you know what I mean). 

  
...Anyone have a local coding solution they use that could run on just 6GB of VRAM? Everthing I've tried in the past straight-up sucked. Was unable to accomplish even the most rudimentary task. Smaller QWEN models couldn't even build a Hello World screen. 

But I know I haven't tried everything yet.

comments.author: Recoil42
comments.body:
No chance, not unless you have another 500GB DRAM and even then not really. 

You have other choices. Claude, DeepSeek, GLM, Gemini Carbon are all great.

replies.author: AsparagusOk8818
replies.body: ...That's fair. I suppose the real solution is to use a good aggregator instead of directly paying OpenAI.

comments.author: fatheadlifter
comments.body: Nothing is that small and compact yet.  And local agentic AI isn't really a thing, at least not something that can run within the memory that mortals possess.
